source: Original procedural PCM generated by src/sound.mjs. No external recordings, audio files, CDN or audio dependency.
controls: Default on; home/pause mute toggle with separate device preference, trusted-gesture AudioContext unlock, pause/background stops, long sounds resume from Game remaining time, no stale short-cue replay.
gameplay_contract: Only optional guarded onCue notifications and presentation callbacks; no changes to payout/RNG/save formats.
browser_device_validation: UNVERIFIED; PCM and AudioContext doubles tested, browser mute harness syntax-checked only; no actual device audition.
rollback: SOUND_ENABLED=false with cache version bump/repackage or use mute preference; retain game saves, latest validators and preference key.
post_release_bookkeeping: Receipt and final handoff updates remain local; no second deployment solely for bookkeeping.
